axes.xDefinition: log10 stellar mass from Prospector-alpha SED fitting (Chabrier IMF)
axes.yDefinition: log10 SFR averaged over the most recent 100 Myr, ridge (mode of the SFR distribution at fixed mass and redshift) of the full galaxy population, no star-forming pre-selection

representation.equation: log SFR = a (M - Mt) + c for M > Mt and b (M - Mt) + c for M <= Mt, M = log10 M*/Msun; each of a, b, c, Mt = X0 + X1 z + X2 z^2 (Eq. 3-4, Table 1)

selection.population: all galaxies (no star-forming pre-selection); the ridge is the density peak of the star-forming sequence
selection.warning: Fit to the normalizing-flow density field over 0.2<z<3.0, mass-complete samples (COSMOS-2015 at 0.2<z<0.8, 3D-HST at 0.5<z<3.0; limits from Leja+20, raised by 0.1-0.25 dex at some redshifts). Mass range shown in the paper's fit figure is log M* = 8.82 to 11.3; this range is read from the digitised plot, the paper does not state it. Deviations of the fit from the density field are <~0.1 dex (paper). SED-based SFRs and masses (Prospector-alpha, nonparametric continuity SFH) sit 0.2-0.5 dex below UV+IR based sequences, see the paper's Section 5.

provenance.citation: Leja et al. 2022, ApJ 936, 165 (arXiv:2110.04314), Eqs. 3-4 and Table 1

records.notes: Coefficients parsed from the arXiv source Table 1. Verification: the expression with the quoted coefficients reproduces the six solid fit lines of the paper's parameterized-moments figure (z=0.3, 0.6, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.7) with rms 0.002-0.004 dex (max 0.006), and a free fit of z to each line returns the legend redshift to <=0.012. The plotted lines start at log M* = {"0.3": 8.99, "0.6": 8.82, "1.0": 9.07, "1.5": 9.64, "2.0": 9.86, "2.7": 10.08} (by redshift; the mass-complete limits) and end at 11.3. Cosmology: Om = Omega_b + Omega_c = 0.0464 + 0.235 = 0.2814 (WMAP9, H0=69.7). The paper does not say here whether the stellar mass is the surviving or the formed mass.
